FulfmtRoutgCriteriaCond.name: FulfmtRoutgCriteriaCond
FulfmtRoutgCriteriaCond.description: Stores atomic conditions that make up fulfillment criteria logic, with globally unique identifiers.

FulfmtRoutgCriteriaId.description: The numeric identifier used in the rule's expression to reference this condition. Must be unique within the rule and used in logical expressions.

Identifier.description: An operator that determines the type of comparison performed on the left and right sides of the condition.

LastReferencedDate.description: The timestamp when the current user last accessed this record indirectly, for example, through a list view or related record.

LastViewedDate.description: The timestamp when the current user last viewed this record or list view. If this value is null, the user might have only accessed this record or list view (LastReferencedDate), but not viewed it.

LeftEntity.description: A field on the left entity that specifies which property of the entity to check for comparison.

LeftField.description: The target entity for comparisons when comparing two entity fields. NULL when comparing against a literal value.

Operator.description: An operator that determines the type of comparison performed on the left and right sides of the condition.

RightEntity.description: The field on the right entity for comparisons when comparing two entity fields. NULL when comparing against a literal value.

RightField.description: Literal value for comparisons when comparing against a constant value. NULL when comparing two entity fields.

RightValue.description: Literal value for comparisons when comparing against a constant value. NULL when comparing two entity fields.
